message.content: The title of “best movie” can vary depending on who you ask—critics, audiences, or award bodies—but many consider **“Parasite”** (2019) to have carried its momentum into 2020, especially after winning the Academy Award for Best Picture in early 2020. If you’re looking at 2020 releases specifically, critics often highlighted **“Tenet”**, **“Soul”**, and **“The Trial of the Chicago 7”** as standout films. Ultimately, the “best” film is subjective, so it helps to think about what you value most—storytelling, technical achievement, cultural impact—and then pick from the top contenders of that year.
